CCR009 return assistance

Help preparing your CCR009 return

Make sense of the information required and prepare your records with practical support.

Priced to scope

Standalone CCR009 assistance is priced for the work agreed. If you already have a continuing authorisation-assistance subscription after FCA approval, routine FCA reporting assistance, including CCR007 and CCR009, is included without an additional subscription. Check your existing engagement before arranging separate work.

Scope and pricing confirmed before engagement. Your firm remains responsible for its submission. Administrative assistance, not legal or regulatory advice.

<%= guideBookingLabel %> →Explore CCR009 return assistance

views/partials/guide_ongoing_offer.ejs.text:
Ongoing compliance support

Turn your review into a practical action list

Get administrative help with documentation, record keeping and periodic reviews within an agreed scope. Bring the issue you want to organise and the records you already hold.

Scope and monthly fee agreed before work begins

Support is provided on a fair-use basis. Scope, frequency and fees depend on the work required; additional work is agreed in advance. Administrative assistance, not legal or regulatory advice. Your firm remains responsible for its obligations.
